# Entitlements & Plan Screen Checklist: Plans & Entitlements (client)

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the gate, refresh, billing-policy and Plan screen requirements before tasks
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Defaults used (no interactive answers; owner away, delegated): depth Standard, audience PR reviewer,
focus = gate correctness + billing policy (P-12) and refresh/offline behaviour. Reviewed by the
delegated session; items marked `[x]` were satisfied as written or after the spec fix noted.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the gate's answers defined for the signed-out state? [Gap, Spec §FR-002] → fixed: FR-002 now says off / 0 while signed out.
- [x] CHK002 Are all five capability keys and their kinds (flag vs quota) enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §5]
- [x] CHK003 Are every refresh trigger and which triggers may be skipped specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006] → fixed: "not entitled" refresh added to the never-skipped list.
- [x] CHK004 Is the Plan screen's loading state defined before the subscription is first read? [Gap, Spec §FR-015] → fixed: loading placeholder for status and dates.
- [x] CHK005 Are unexpected refresh errors (not offline) specified, including the request id? [Gap, Spec §FR-015, P-13.2] → fixed.
- [x] CHK006 Is logging of subscription details and prices addressed? [Gap, P-09.2] → fixed: FR-021.
- [x] CHK007 Is sign-out clearing of every billing record specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, §3]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 Is "unlimited" defined unambiguously in terms of the server's value? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK009 Is the price source (channel) defined so no reviewer could show an InstaPay price? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK010 Are the subscription status labels and date rules (renews / ends / no end date / grace) defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, US2]
- [x] CHK011 Is "current plan" matching defined by identifier rather than name? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK012 Is the 60-second foreground floor stated as a measurable rule? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Do US1 scenario 3 and SC-002 agree with the 60-second foreground floor? [Consistency, Spec §US1, §SC-002]
- [x] CHK014 Is the plan name's source (entitlements) consistent when the subscription read disagrees? [Conflict, Spec §FR-011, §FR-012] → fixed: status/dates hidden until both name the same plan; edge case added.
- [x] CHK015 Do the Plan screen requirements stay consistent with P-12.3 (only restore / enter code, none built here)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK016 Is a refresh arriving after sign-out or for another person covered? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Is the retired-plan case (current plan absent from the catalogue) covered? [Coverage, Spec §US3-5]
- [x] CHK018 Is the shared-wallet "owner's plan governs" limitation stated for consumers of the gate? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, §6]
- [x] CHK019 Are offline first-open and never-loaded catalogue cases covered? [Coverage, Spec §US2-6, §US3-6]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK020 Are screen-reader requirements defined for the plan card? [Gap, Spec §FR-019] → fixed: each card announced as one item.
- [x] CHK021 Are RTL, 200% font and Western-digit requirements stated for the new screen? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, §FR-014]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK022 Are backend contract gaps recorded with an owner and a non-blocking fallback? [Assumption, Spec §9]
- [x] CHK023 Is the dependency on C1 and the deferral of downgrade copy to C9 recorded? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions, Clarifications]
